item.title: Notes
item.description:
Below are some notes I took when studying mathematics (at school or on my own). They contain many mistakes.

  • Homological Algebra
    (To be uploaded) Notes of Hilton & Stammbach’s A Course of Homological Algebra.
  • Commutative Algebra
    (To be uploaded) Notes of Atiyah’s Introduction to Commutative Algebra.
  • Algebraic Curves
    (To be uploaded) Lecture notes of Algebraic Curve at BIMSA + Notes of Fulton’s Algebraic Curves.
  • Algebraic Topology
    Lecture notes of Algebraic Topology at USC.
  • Enumerative Combinatorics
    Lecture notes of Combinatorial Analysis at USC.
  • Galois Theory
    Notes of Milne’s Field & Galois Theory.
  • Riemannian Geometry
    (To be uploaded) Notes of Lee’s Introduction to Riemannian Manifolds + do Carmo’s Riemannian Geometry.
  • Directed Reading: Infinity Categories
    Notes on Infinity Category Theory supervised by Joseph Helfer.
  • Point-Set Topology
    Notes of Munkres’s Topology.

And here are some notes that might or might not come.
